findings.governingReading: Auh
findings.explanation: Shirou’s chastened vocalization becomes an assent-like noise.

findings.highlight: I’d be doing the same thing to you
findings.evidenceJa: 今すぐ士郎にやり返してる
findings.governingReading: I would be retaliating against you right now
findings.explanation: Rin’s nonspecific threat of payback becomes an apparent promise to perform the same sexual act on Shirou.

findings.highlight: I close my right hand in front of Tohsaka.
findings.evidenceJa: むっ、と見据えてくる遠坂の前で、ぎゅっと右手を握ってみる
findings.governingReading: before Rin’s firm glare, he tightly clenches his right hand
findings.explanation: Rin’s expression and the force of Shirou’s test gesture disappear.

findings.highlight: I believe our contract is there
findings.evidenceJa: 契約は完璧に結ばれたのだろう
findings.governingReading: the contract must have been perfectly concluded
findings.explanation: A complete technical conclusion becomes vague belief that a contract merely exists.

findings.highlight: I’m going to get you back someday
findings.evidenceJa: かならず仕返ししてやる
findings.governingReading: I will definitely get you back
findings.explanation: An unsupported indefinite delay weakens Rin’s emphatic threat.

findings.evidenceJa: 覚悟なさい、と涙目で睨んでくる
findings.governingReading: “Brace yourself,” Rin says with a tearful glare
findings.explanation: The command and the tears that complicate Rin’s anger disappear.

findings.highlight: the magical energy pouring into me
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に流れてくる遠坂からの魔力
findings.governingReading: Rin’s mana flowing into him
findings.explanation: The source of the incoming mana is omitted at the moment Shirou first senses the connection.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: Shirou’s surname is misspelled.

findings.highlight: her maximum capacity could reach a thousand
findings.evidenceJa: 供給してくれるモノさえあれば、最大許容量は千に届くかも知れない
findings.governingReading: provided something supplies her, her maximum capacity may reach one thousand
findings.explanation: The condition that Rin needs an external supply to reach the estimated maximum disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 常備五百もの魔力を持っている
findings.governingReading: she routinely keeps five hundred units’ worth of mana
findings.explanation: An amount of mana is rendered as though “magical energy” were a countable object.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔力量は四百ほど
findings.governingReading: about four hundred units of mana
findings.explanation: The same uncountable noun error recurs in the current-capacity estimate.

findings.evidenceJa: 三十回、六十回と出来る
findings.governingReading: thirty or even sixty times
findings.explanation: Two explicit estimates demonstrating the scale of Rin’s support are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 万全の態勢で最後の夜を迎えよう
findings.governingReading: meet the final night in perfect condition
findings.explanation: The object and emotional endpoint of Shirou’s resolution disappear.
